goal: Establish the real portfolio/evidence baseline and publication-rights truth required for public proof.
stop_conditions: Do not publish a couple, guest, minor, venue testimonial or private asset with unknown/insufficient rights.
Do not infer consent from Drive/storage availability.
Styled/editorial shoots must be labeled truthfully and may not be represented as client weddings.
promotion_rule: A target buyer can be shown credible permissioned work, each public asset has known provenance/rights state, and critical portfolio gaps have a concrete acquisition plan.
